title: Verify successful login with valid admin credentials
preconditions: Application is running on the staging URL
Admin account exists with username: admin@example.com
test_steps: 2. Observe the Login page with 'Email' and 'Password' fields
expected_result: Admin is redirected to the Admin Dashboard. The navigation sidebar shows 'User Management', 'Reports', and 'Settings' menu items.

title: Verify login fails with incorrect password
expected_result: Login fails. Error message 'Invalid email or password. Please try again.' is displayed. User remains on the Login page.

title: Verify password field rejects passwords shorter than 8 characters
preconditions: Admin is on the 'Add User' or 'Change Password' form
test_steps: 1. Navigate to User Management > Add User
4. Enter 'Ab1!' in the 'Password' field (4 characters — below minimum)
expected_result: Form submission is blocked. Inline error message displayed: 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.'

title: Verify admin can create a new manager account with all valid data
test_steps: 1. Click 'Add User' button on the Users page
2. Enter 'Jane Smith' in the 'Full Name' field
expected_result: Success message shown: 'User created successfully'. New user 'Jane Smith' appears in the Users list with role 'Manager'. A welcome email is sent to jane.smith@example.com.

title: Verify manager cannot edit audit log entries
test_steps: 4. Observe the audit log table with columns: User, Action, Timestamp
5. Attempt to click on any audit log row to edit it
expected_result: Audit log is displayed in read-only mode. No 'Edit' or 'Delete' buttons are visible. Clicking a row shows details but no editable fields.
